title: TerrainLabel
description: Label of terrain/{id}.bin, the terrain patch for the 3D view (Contract 4). The .bin holds n * n little-endian Float32 heights, rows north to south, columns west to east. Sample (row i, column j) is at east = (j - (n-1)/2) * spacing_m, north = ((n-1)/2 - i) * spacing_m in the level plane of the site; its value is the ground height above that plane, metres, measured along the vertical of the site. Centre value is 0. Display only.

version.description: Format version of this file. Increased on any format change.

elev_m.description: Ground height at the site (the patch centre), metres above the 1737.4 km sphere.

size_m.description: Side length of the patch, metres: (n - 1) * spacing_m.

n.description: Samples per side. Odd, so that the site is the centre sample.

dem.description: Names of the elevation map(s) used. Show this with every result.

resolution_m.description: Pixel size of the finest elevation map used near the point, metres. Show this with every result.
